data.name: DARWIN
data.abstract: The DARWIN dataset includes handwriting data from 174 participants. The classification task consists in distinguishing Alzheimer’s disease patients from healthy people.

intro_paper.title: Diagnosing Alzheimer’s disease from on-line handwriting: A novel dataset and performance benchmarking
intro_paper.authors: Nicole D. Cilia, Giuseppe De Gregorio , Claudio De Stefano, Francesco Fontanella, Angelo Marcelli, Antonio Parziale

additional_info.purpose: The DARWIN dataset was created to allow researchers to improve the existing machine learning methodologies for the prediction of Alzheimer's disease via handwriting analysis.
